root: ^And the little garden will still be there tomorrow. I need to catch a couple of hours of sleep before my night shift Erin.
^But then I have nothing to dooooo :(
^Sit tight, we'll take a look tomorrow when I'm off work

day_01: ^...here. As good a place as any.
^On this bare patch of land I shall make my garden.
^That's where I'm carrying our groceries, aka all your precious snacks!
^Cute. But, the little garden will still be there tomorrow.
^I need to catch a couple of Zs before my night shift Hon. Come on.
^But then I have nothing to dooooo
^Sit tight, we'll take a look tomorrow after I'm done with work.
^...they made a new patch of dirt. Right next to my house. Lovely.
^What do I even pay property taxes for when the municipality uses it on ugly, useless nonsence like this.
^They should have put down some flowers immedeatly. This will be overrun with weeds and god knows what before the week is up.
^Bertie had left some tulip bulbs in the window boxes.
^I can leave the house a little. I'm 8! That's almost 10!
^Oh. I didn't know tulips could grow that fast.
^In the end Bertie did get me into his silly little hobby after all. Sly old fox.
^Mom, can we look at the garden thingy today?
^Those usually don't pop up overnight hon. Honestly Erin, I still need to-
^Oh! Mrs. Weylin. I hadn't seen you around much.
^I'm doing fine, thank you for asking.
^It's not the daintylion I planted yesterday though.
^It's not "your garden Ruth", it's a community garden.
^I'm not yelling at my kid for that.
^I watch my kid just fine. Can mind her own damn buissness.
^But I want to plant something! Before Mrs. Waylin takes control of everything-
^Tomorrow Erin, I still have to get the car fixed today.
^Dinner's in the fridge, I'll be home as soon as I can.
^Erin, when exactly did you plant a dandelion? You were asleep when I got home last night.
^Erin Garcia Mendez. You know better than to leave the house without someone to watch you!
^Mom look! The flower I planted grew up!
^Erin dear, that is a weed. Stop spreading the seeds around, you're making this so called community project more hopeless than it already was.
^Erin, I really don't have time for this.
^No Mrs. Wylin, I planted this myself! I'ts my favorite flower, I think.
